notes.title: New update coming soon!
notes.content:
🚀 Big News for RotoBrix Fans! 🚀

Get ready to fall in love with RotoBrix all over again! It’s been 5 years since our original release, and we’ve been quietly working behind the scenes to breathe new life into your favorite arcade puzzle game. Here’s what’s coming:

🎮 Controller Support: Experience RotoBrix with the precision and comfort of your favorite controller!
🕹️ Steam Deck Support: Play RotoBrix anywhere with full compatibility for the Steam Deck!
🐛 Bug Fixes: We’ve squashed long-standing bugs to make your gameplay smoother than ever.
⚖️ Difficulty Balancing: Whether you're a newcomer or a seasoned pro, the challenge will hit that sweet spot.

Stay tuned for updates as we prepare to roll out these enhancements! If you haven’t picked up RotoBrix yet, now’s the perfect time to dive in and see what all the buzz is about. Don’t miss your chance to grab this retro-inspired gem—available now on Steam!

✨ It’s time to rebuild the hype. Are you ready? ✨
